biomarkers.name: Grade (definitionally grade 1)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Excellent prognosis; chemotherapy typically not required if small and node-negative

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Well-formed angulated tubules with open lumens lined by a single cell layer

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Luminal epithelial cells with well-differentiated ductal phenotype
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Extremely well-differentiated — angulated tubules with single-cell layer; ER+/PR+/HER2- (nearly universal luminal A biology)
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Represents most differentiated end of luminal breast cancer spectrum with retained ductal architecture
